steps.title: Setup App Meta Data
steps.description: Initialize app-meta.json with package name com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app and app name Native Image Text Replacer.

steps.title: Configure Android Build Script
steps.description: Create high compatibility app/build.gradle with Android Gradle Plugin (AGP) 8.3.2, compileSdk 34, targetSdk 34, minSdk 21, and Java 8 compiler options.

steps.title: Configure Android Manifest
steps.description: Prepare AndroidManifest.xml declaring correct package com.nativeimagetextreplacer.app, MainActivity, system material theme, and required launcher configurations.

steps.title: Define TextBlock Model
steps.description: Create the TextBlock.java model to represent bounding coordinates, original texts, replacement texts, and styling attributes such as colors, sizes, alignment, and formatting.

steps.title: Implement Interactive Canvas EditorView
steps.description: Build custom EditorView.java that manages coordinate scaling, renders background images, renders dynamic patch cleanups, processes 8-point resize handle gestures, and handles multi-touch translation events.

steps.title: Develop Smart Style Heuristics Analyzer
steps.description: Implement localized background and text color sampling inside EditorView to extract background fill colors and foreground text colors dynamically from the original bitmap pixels.

steps.title: Create Layout Architecture XML
steps.description: Design activity_main.xml with a top header action bar, full-screen interactive FrameLayout workspace, horizontal dynamic chip selection slider, and a slide-up styling control panel.

steps.title: Establish View Controller Wiring
steps.description: Configure MainActivity.java to bind UI widgets, handle photo picker intents, synchronize styling updates, change text alignment, handle dynamic bold attributes, and display horizontal chips.

steps.title: Build Color Selection Palettes
steps.description: Generate circular clickable color buttons for both foreground text and background replacement fill inside MainActivity dynamically using code.

steps.title: Implement High-Resolution PNG Exporter
steps.description: Incorporate low-level Canvas bitmap operations to draw localized back-patches and replacement texts onto a high-quality mutable copy of the original bitmap and save to storage.

steps.title: Building Native Image Text Replacer
steps.description: Compile the complete offline Java + XML code into a production ready build using Gradle 8.5 on Temurin 17 Java runner.
